item: Topic thesauri built on the operator's machine and checked before use (R737)
summary: A deterministic build command turns a downloaded SKOS file (or, only with --online, one fetched from the publisher's hosts) into the data directory's thesauri folder with a small counts-and-hashes summary to send back; the app uses a built file only when its format and SHA-256 match its summary and says why otherwise (Law panel, GET /api/law/thesauri).
